### Faithfully Fishing - The Crosswalk Devotional - January 28
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/faithfully-fishing-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 4:19
Points:
- Jesus calls believers to an active mission rather than passive waiting inside church walls.
- Following Christ requires stepping out of comfort zones into the everyday presence of people.
- Discipleship centers on extendable invitations rather than coercion or forced outcomes.
- Believers are not expected to be saviors, but simply to point others toward Jesus.

### “Because Jesus Said So” - Girlfriends in God - March 23, 2015
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/because-jesus-said-so-girlfriends-in-god-march-23-2015.html
Passage: Luke 5:5
Points:
- Peter chose obedience to Christ despite a night of exhausting, fruitless labor.
- Following God's guidance often means trusting His words above personal expertise.
- Surrendering our doubts to simple obedience opens the door to God's abundance.
- The greatest reward was not the catch of fish, but leaving everything to follow Jesus.
